name: @opening-cross/clearing-wasm
description: The Opening Cross clearing rule, the same clearing-core that runs on chain, compiled to WebAssembly with a typed loader for browsers and Node.

scripts.build: cargo build -p clearing-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-opt -Oz --strip-debug --strip-producers ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/clearing_wasm.wasm -o clearing.wasm
scripts.build:v2: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/clearing_wasm_v2.wasm clearing-v2.wasm
